# Jeep vehicle asset

Jeep by DJMaesen (bumstrum)

Author-built model (18,417 triangles in public metadata; 18,415 triangles in the imported runtime geometry), original UVs, interior, axles, suspension, independent tires and nine PBR/alpha images. Source maps are native 1024 x 1024; they are not presented as native 2K scans. Source dimensions retained (about 3.98 m long, 2.12 m wide, 1.84 m high).

Changes: baked object transforms, changed nose to -Z, grounded tires, moved wheel pivots to their actual centers, lossless geometry attributes, photographic-style authored wear textures re-encoded as JPEG/PNG. Vehicle copies share geometry and images. Original GLB is retained outside the runtime output in source-assets/jeep/original.glb. No manufacturer endorsement implied.
